actual_scope: Independently rebuild the known unrestricted 14-point F2^6 difference-basis minimum and apply it, with source-add census controls, to prove the global six-source DUO batch optimum (140 queries,142 adds). Retain the exact (13,16) word/deletion census as a separate restricted cross-check.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for a new operation family. This continues PR2128 within the existing DUO alphabet. After completing the 16-add handoff, a literature checkpoint identified Gavrylkiv 2017 Table 3 and prompted a bounded independent affine-basis-normalized census; neither the old basis value nor the predecessor witness is claimed as new.
bottleneck_link: The declared abstract connector tariff is now closed: the predecessor simultaneously attains the minimum batch query count and add count, so larger source-add budgets cannot buy a better query/add point under these rules. Future progress needs physical implementation or a changed observation/connector contract; no selected exponent improvement follows.
stop_rule: Each of two first waves was limited to 20 minutes and 1 GiB aggregate process RSS. The restricted search used three local CPU workers and exhausted in 3.097 seconds; the unrestricted basis follow-up used two and exhausted in 2.077 seconds, including its launcher. Incomplete receipts reject. The investigation stops after independent reconstruction, dirty-column replay, complete batch accounting and publication; no higher-add blind search.
evidence: Two independent implementations enumerate all 36,288,252 affine-basis-normalized 13-point sets and agree on the entire coverage histogram: maximum 63/64, with 4,200 attaining normalized sets. This independently reproduces the lower bound reported in Gavrylkiv 2017 Table 3; the predecessor 14-point witness is a positive control. A separate pair enumerates all 54,864,810 normalized 16-add unit words and agrees on the complete 7,480-word table; a literal Python audit checks 86,900 legal midpoint triples over 251 complete orbits. Both native basis enumerations pass complete UBSan runs. Full replay checks 256 affine normalization controls, all 70/140/210 dirty input columns, four behavioral mutants, three deadline gates and exact query/add lower bounds. The only abstract Pareto point is (140,142); no physical supplier or kappa claim.
